title: People Movement Analytics Event
description: Schema for people movement tracking events in a casino/gaming environment, capturing foot traffic, dwell times, queue detection, and zone occupancy from various sensor types

event_id.description: Unique UUID for this movement event record

sensor_id.description: Unique identifier for the sensor device, format SENS-XXXX

sensor_type.description: Type of sensor that generated the movement event

zone_id.description: Unique identifier for the casino zone being monitored

zone_name.description: Human-readable name of the casino zone, e.g. 'High Limit Slots', 'Main Entrance'

timestamp.description: UTC date-time when the movement event was captured

person_count.description: Number of persons detected in the sensor field at event time

direction.description: Observed direction of movement relative to the zone boundary

dwell_time_seconds.description: Duration in seconds a person or group has remained within the zone

velocity_mps.description: Estimated walking speed in meters per second

x_coordinate.description: Horizontal position within the zone coordinate system

y_coordinate.description: Vertical position within the zone coordinate system

floor_level.description: Building floor level where the sensor is located

heat_map_cell.description: Grid reference for heat map visualization, e.g. 'A1', 'B3'

occupancy_percentage.description: Current zone occupancy as a percentage of maximum capacity

queue_detected.description: True if a queue formation has been detected in the zone

queue_length.description: Estimated number of persons in the detected queue

queue_wait_minutes.description: Estimated average wait time in minutes for the detected queue

device_mac_hash.description: SHA-256 hashed MAC address for Wi-Fi probe tracking, preserving anonymity

signal_strength_dbm.description: Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) in dBm for wireless sensors

battery_level.description: Sensor battery charge level as a percentage

calibration_date.description: Date when the sensor was last calibrated

load_time.description: Timestamp when the record was loaded into the pipeline
